analysis.summary: Management stated that FY26 was an important year driven by fleet expansion and operational enhancements, leading to consolidated total income of INR322.64 crores and PAT of INR80.80 crores. For FY27, the company expects a conservative top-line increase of about 10% and EBITDA margins to remain in the 45% to 50% band. The company is actively focusing on disciplined fleet expansion, offshore capabilities, and maintaining long-term charter relationships across the maritime sector. ABS Marine Services Limited reported a total consolidated income of ₹322.64 Cr and a net profit of ₹80.80 Cr for FY26. Management highlighted fleet expansion initiatives, including the induction of OSV HADES and delivery of a Multi-Purpose Offshore Support Vessel (MPSV), to capture rising offshore energy demand.

guidance.claim: Management expects a top-line increase of approximately 10% for the current financial year FY27.
guidance.quote: As regards the guidance on the top line is concerned, we can expect a 10% increase -- assuming that all the vessels will be running in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects EBITDA margins to continue in the 45% to 50% band.
guidance.quote: As regards the EBITDA is concerned, I am sure that currently it is in the band of 45 to 50. I am sure that that will continue.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the demand for oil drilling and production programs requires vessels, keeping demand strong.
demand_outlook.quote: So, looking at that, we feel that the demand for all these kind of any oil drilling program or production program, you need vessels. And that is where we come in. So, we hope that the demand will be always there quite strong.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that ONGC has a pending tender for about 20 vessels.
demand_outlook.quote: See, demand is as of -- as we talk now, ONGC is asking for about 20-vessel tender is going to come.

demand_outlook.claim: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents.
demand_outlook.quote: Offshore investments are rising steadily across continents

capex_expansion.claim: Management successfully inducted the offshore support vessel Artemis into the owned fleet during H2 FY26.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of this strategy, during H2 FY26, we successfully inducted the offshore support vessel, Artemis, into our owned fleet, expanding our vessel ownership portfolio and improving our ability to participate in higher-value offshore projects.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Further enhancing our offshore capabilities, we are also scheduled to take delivery of an offshore supply vessel in Q1 FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that approximately $15 million was spent for both new vessels.
capex_expansion.quote: Just a moment. We have totally, we have spent about $15 million for both the vessels.

margins_costs.claim: Consolidated EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28% in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased significantly by 179.17% to INR152.55 crores, while the EBITDA margin expanded sharply by 1,763 basis points to 47.28%.

margins_costs.claim: Management estimated the idle vessel cost at approximately $1,700 a day.
margins_costs.quote: So, let's put it as a ballpoint figure, it's about $1,700 a day.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that fuel efficiency provides a huge advantage as fuel prices have increased.
margins_costs.quote: That is true because we have this huge advantage in fuel.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management contributed to growth in revenue and profitability.
margins_costs.quote: Improved utilization levels, better margin realization, and disciplined cost management have contributed to healthy growth in both revenue and profitability.

orders_capacity.claim: Management operates a diversified fleet supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.
orders_capacity.quote: Today, we operate a diversified fleet with offices in Mumbai, Kochi, Singapore, and Kakinada, supported by over 2,000 seafarers and shore-based professionals.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that out of eight owned vessels, five are on long-term charter, two have just come out of charter, and a third newly acquired vessel goes into dry dock.
orders_capacity.quote: Out of the eight vessels that we own, five of them are on long-term charter, three of them -- two of them have just come out of charter, and third one is just we have acquired, so it has to go into the dry dock and then only come out and then only we put her in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that the total fleet stands at 12 vessels including four smaller vessels on long-term charter.
orders_capacity.quote: No, 12 number is correct. The other four vessels are smaller vessels, they are on long-term charter.

orders_capacity.claim: The company secured over ₹350 Cr in strategic contracts including offshore vessel charters and port contracts.
orders_capacity.quote: Over ₹350 Cr in Strategic Contracts Secured

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated that the debt-equity ratio is comfortable for lenders.
capital_allocation.quote: At this point of time with our debt-equity ratio the banks are also comfortable. I don't think we have overshot on the debt side.

capital_allocation.claim: Management explained that tonnage tax is calculated based on vessel tonnage rather than earnings.
capital_allocation.quote: So, what they do is they tax not as per the earnings, they tax on the tonnage of the vessel.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that exchange rate fluctuations impact vessel acquisition costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The premium is only because of the exchange rate. Other than that, I don't see much change in this because from what we were paying INR82 per dollar, it has gone up to INR96.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management stated that offshore EPC contractors avoid working during the monsoon season due to safety risks.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the monsoon, they cannot work. Considering risk of there was a huge loss of life and all that, so they are very careful that they should not work with during the monsoon time.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.
risks_headwinds.quote: Such forward-looking statements are not guarantee of future performance and are subject to known and unknown risks, uncertainties and assumptions that are difficult to predict.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to expand the fleet by adding seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.
management_commitments.quote: I think Captain has already told that the vision is to expand and to go forward for seven to eight vessels over a period of two to three years.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the second year operation with Schlumberger is underway for AM Passion.
management_commitments.quote: And now we are on the second year operation with them.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that charter rates for AM Passion will increase to $19,000 in the third year.
management_commitments.quote: And then the next three years, it will be at $19,000.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a commitment to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.
management_commitments.quote: We stay committed to building a robust asset base that drives operational efficiency, enhances service delivery, and supports sustainable long-term growth.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
